//: TypeScript settings shared by every package in this workspace.
The strictness here is deliberate and matches the Rust side's: the Cargo
workspace denies warnings in CI, and a TypeScript package that allows
implicit `any` or an unchecked index would be held to a lower standard
Nothing emits. Vite compiles the sources it bundles, and `npm run
typecheck` at the workspace root is what checks the types - including the
sources of `packages/*`, which are consumed as TypeScript rather than
built to `dist`, so there is no build order to get wrong and no stale
